resources.string: Akukhonakalanga ukususa iakhawunti yakho. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana kwakho uzame futhi.

Lokhu kususa unomphela amaCoin akho lomlando wawo, lokho owawasebenzisela khona, imali yakho egcinweyo leyakho oyenzileyo, kanye lokungena kwakho.\n\nAmaCoin owawathengayo ayafakwa njalo awenelisi ukubuyiselwa loba ukubuyiselwa imali. Lokhu akulakuguqulwa.
AmaCoin akho akulolu ucingo kuphela. Ngena ukuze uwagcine nxa uguqula ucingo.
AmaCoin akho lezintengo kugcinwe kule akhawunti.
Akukhonakalanga ukungena. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana kwakho uzame futhi.
Ukungena nge-Google akuphelelanga. Zama nge-imeyili, loba uzame futhi muva.
Le imeyili isilayo iakhawunti njalo iphasiwedi kayifanani layo
